control._why: Few creatures to kill: cut the cheap creature removal and the wipe. More counters and discard for a slow, spell-heavy opponent, and a second Emeritus as an extra threat.

midrange._why: Creature fights: Day of Black Sun and an extra Deadly Cover-Up for wide boards, Qarsi Revenant as a flying deathtouch lifelink body. Cuts discard and the narrow counter.

aggro._why: Survive the early turns: Day of Black Sun for cheap creatures, Qarsi Revenant to block and gain life, Flashfreeze vs red or green spells. Cuts the slow card draw and discard.
